# i18n expansion

[中文](i18n_issue_body.md) | English

## Problem

Memex ships **17 UI locales**: English (`en`), Simplified Chinese (`zh`), Traditional Chinese (`zh_Hant`), German (`de`), Japanese (`ja`), Korean (`ko`), Spanish (`es`), Hindi (`hi`), Arabic (`ar`), Portuguese (`pt`), French (`fr`), Indonesian (`id`), Persian (`fa`), Vietnamese (`vi`), Thai (`th`), Turkish (`tr`), and Russian (`ru`). The original expansion list is complete.

This file previously said Memex only supported English and Simplified Chinese. Update it whenever a locale lands so contributors do not re-add languages that already exist.

## Proposed solution

Maintain the same two-layer localization setup for every shipped locale and keep platform registration in sync.

### 1. ARB files (short UI strings)

- `lib/l10n/app_en.arb` — template, 800+ keys
- Each locale needs `app_<locale>.arb`

### 2. `AppLocalizationsExt` (long-form copy)

- `lib/l10n/app_localizations_ext.dart` — mixin for agent prompts, onboarding, OAuth HTML, default characters, share copy
- Each locale needs `app_localizations_ext_<locale>.dart` and a branch in `lookupAppLocalizationsExt()`

### 3. Config

- `l10n.yaml` — no change (ARB files are auto-discovered)
- `app_localizations.dart` — `supportedLocales` (generated by `flutter gen-l10n`)
- `lib/l10n/supported_languages.dart` — language picker entries
- `ios/Runner/Info.plist` — `CFBundleLocalizations`
- `android/app/src/main/res/values-<locale>/strings.xml` — app name and shortcuts

### 4. RTL (Arabic)

Arabic is already shipped. Keep verifying layouts under `TextDirection.rtl`.

### 5. Agent prompt quality

`*LanguageInstruction` properties on `AppLocalizationsExt` affect LLM output. New locales need native review of those strings, not only UI labels.

## Implementation approach

1. Machine translation for the ARB skeleton, then native review — especially agent prompts
2. After the skeleton lands, mark the locale `help wanted` + `good first issue` for native speakers
3. CI should fail if ARB key sets drift across locales

## Checklist

- [x] ARB files for the original 11 expansion locales (ko, ja, zh_Hant, es, hi, ar, pt, fr, ru, de, id)
- [x] `AppLocalizationsExt` implementations for those locales
- [x] `lookupAppLocalizationsExt()` switch cases
- [x] Persian (`fa`) ARB + Ext
- [x] Vietnamese (`vi`) ARB + Ext
- [x] Thai (`th`) ARB + Ext
- [x] Turkish (`tr`) ARB + Ext
- [x] iOS `Info.plist` locales beyond `en` / `zh-Hans`
- [x] Android `values-<locale>/strings.xml` per locale
- [ ] Arabic RTL layout pass
- [ ] Missing-key CI lint
- [ ] Native review per language
